messages:
emma: Quick logistics question  the orientation invite says 11:00 AM PT. A few of our new hires are in IST and AESTwhat's the best public link to share after the call?
onboarding-bot: Event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-2025-main. Recording will be uploaded to the event and to Drive under /onboarding/recordings within 20-30 minutes.
rob: Hi @emma  we post three artifacts after the session: 1) full recording, 2) 20-min quick-watch, 3) slides + transcript. All links go into the calendar event and the Notion "New Hire Hub".
carlos: Small timezone snag: when I export the .ics for some folks on Outlook it shows the wrong timezone and duplicates the invite. Any known fixes?
julie: Carlos  that's usually because attendees import the .ics after already accepting the Google invite. Workaround: accept the Google invite (best), or import the .ics and then delete the Google event to avoid duplicates. We're updating the description with a note.
emma: Will the slides be available before the live session so managers can prep role-specific questions?
rob: Yes  slides and agenda are up now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-orient-2025. Agenda includes timestamps for chapters to jump in the trimmed video.
carlos: Also a request: some EMEA hires asked about translated captions. Do we generate translated SRTs or rely on auto-translate?
julie: We auto-generate English captions and run auto-translate for common languages. If a manager needs guaranteed human-verified captions, DM me the names and language and we'll arrange it for the replay.
emma: For APAC folks who can't make the main slot, is there a shorter replay in region-friendly hours?
onboarding-bot: APAC replay event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-apac-2025 at 09:00 AEST on 2025-03-14. Invite sent to new-hires@redwood.com.
rob: Also adding a short link bundle (slides + quick-watch + transcript) to the offer packet. Ping me after the recording posts and I'll make the short URL.
emma: One last thing  I saw people hitting duplicate events when they both accept and import. Could we include an "import .ics only if you can't accept Google invite" line in the top of the description?
julie: Already done  updated the event description with a bold note and a tiny timezone table (PT/ET/CET/IST/AEST) and a step-by-step for import if Outlook users still need it.
emma: Perfect, thanks. If anyone notices broken links after the session, tag @rob and we'll fix them fast. :thumbsup:
